## Summary

**Root cause:** `scripts/i18n-drift-fix.ts`'s docs.api path calls [translate-api-po.ts](docs/scripts/translate-api-po.ts) directly, which only ran `mergePoWithTemplate(po, docs.api.pot)` against whatever `l10n/docs.api.pot` already existed on disk. It never rebuilt the POT from the current `docs/api` tree first (unlike the full `build-api-locales.ts` pipeline, which calls `refreshApiPot()`). Since the `custom-theme-colors` plugin's API docs were new, their strings weren't in the stale committed POT, so `mergePoWithTemplate` had nothing to add — those 516 units (43 locales × 6 files) could never be filled no matter how many times `vpr i18n:drift:fix:copilot` ran, matching the CI log's plateau at 43×n.

**Fix:**
- Extracted `refreshApiPot()` from [build-api-locales.ts](docs/scripts/build-api-locales.ts) into a new shared [refresh-api-pot.ts](docs/scripts/refresh-api-pot.ts).
- [translate-api-po.ts](docs/scripts/translate-api-po.ts) now calls `refreshApiPot()` before merging, so the POT always reflects the live `docs/api` tree.
- Updated [translate-api-po.test.ts](docs/scripts/translate-api-po.test.ts) to mock/assert the new call.

**Verification:** ran `vp check`, the docs/scripts test suite (237 passed), then regenerated EN API docs and ran the copilot-provider drift-fix for `docs.api` — all 43 locales filled with 0 remaining, and `check-locale-drift.ts` now reports no drift. Committed and pushed to `theme-colors`.
